title: fix: preserve timestamped audio cache headers
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Preserves `x-pollinations-response-format` in cached responses so timestamped ElevenLabs results retain their format marker after the durable R2 round trip.
- Waits for request execution contexts in timestamp tests so background cache and tracking work cannot outlive isolated test storage.
- Adds regression coverage for the cached response header.
- Verified with focused Vitest suites, typecheck, Biome, and the production build.

gist.headline: The timestamps survived winter
gist.blurb: Timestamped ElevenLabs audio now keeps its format marker after a trip through the R2 cache. Polli put a label on the jar, which turns out to help.
gist.summary: Cached ElevenLabs timestamped audio responses now preserve the x-pollinations-response-format header through the durable R2 cache round trip, with regression coverage for the cached header.
gist.impact: Apps requesting timestamped ElevenLabs results will continue receiving the format marker on cache hits, so cached and freshly generated audio responses behave consistently.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the R2 cache as a cozy labeled pantry of glowing audio jars: a timestamped waveform jar has a clearly preserved format tag. Polli, wearing tiny archivist glasses, carefully attaches the label while a retro terminal and small code-plants confirm that cached audio still knows what it is.
